name: readable-layout-oc
description: Readable Layout by Garvit Nangru, restyled to match OpenCode: labeled boxes for you and Claude, Claude's notes behind a vertical bar, colored headings and list markers, bold text in color, and a rule at the end of every turn.

boxes.title: Claude text to box
boxes.description: answers boxes replies of more than a line or two and shows one-line notes as quiet lines; all boxes everything Claude writes

bold.title: Bold text
bold.description: color draws bold text in a soft teal; highlight puts a soft background behind it; off leaves it plain bold
